title: The user's 3W decisions from the trainer and the forward blind tests, 2026-10-15/16
notes: Blind cases never show tickers or dates to the user (the user's rule); this file keeps the signal year only.

The case keys (dataset, symbol, signal week) are kept on the research machine in work/v3w/3w-blind-keys-2026-10.json; its SHA-256 is b073d2f9505ada733ff40c96a4585c984233c8ee435f018d341bd1b6f599eb78, so the mapping can be shown unchanged later.
choice: do / no (every 'no' means the user would not trade the shape). reasons use the page's codes: converge, sideways, swing, messy, long, close, unfinished, deep, line, macd, other.
own_order_rebased: the user's optional practice order in prices where the signal week's close = 100 (scored by the 13-week rule).
rule17_R / rule17_same_day_random_R: the case traded by rule 1.7, R capped at +5, and 30 same-day random stocks with the same mechanics (work/v3w/judged17.py).
Earlier judgements (blind tests 1-2, 1.3 check, current list, first random check) are in triangle-user-judgements-2026-10.json.
